channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Kids' Park
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Kids' Park (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Kids' Park: The Kids' Park summary gave the Long Bridge and China Basin location and the P6 label but cited only two articles that contain neither, and it called the opening day 'inconsistently reported'. It now also cites the SF Recreation and Parks facility page (the intersection) and OCII's open-space page (P6), and says that the Urban Life Signs blog gives July 1, 2016 while Mission Bay Parks' own post, dated September 15, 2016, gives no day. The 2015 milestone no longer mentions 'street work', which the blog does not say; it now says the fence stayed up pending a procedural land transfer to the city, with the area around it a construction site.

item.title: Under construction · Mission Bay Kids' Park: Playground construction visibly complete (grass grown in, play equipment and nature huts installed) per contemporaneous local reporting, but fenced off and not yet open to the public, pending a procedural transfer of the redeveloped land to the city (the surrounding area was also a construction site) (~2015)
